usedFor: Render hosts your services and Google Calendar holds the schedule, so “Deploy Finished” runs “Create Calendar Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deploy Finished” in Render, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: Each deploy leaves a calendar event, so the team can see when releases went live or failed.

watchOut: “Deploy Finished” in Render fires on live, failed and canceled deploys, so the event needs to say which.
